<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 6:13">Targ. II Sam. VI, 13</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 28:24">Targ. I Sam. XXVIII, 24</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <he>פַּטִּימִין</he>, <he>פַּטִּימַיָּא</he>.
Targ. I Kings V, 3 עופיא פ׳ (ed. Lag. sing.).
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 45:15">Targ. Ez. XLV, 15</cite> Kimḥi (ed. Lag. <cite ref="Q00517"><he>פטימא</he></cite>; ed. Wil. <cite ref="Q00539"><he>פִּטְמָא</he></cite>); a. fr.—
Y. Peah I, 15ᶜ bot. תרנגולין פ׳ fattened chickens; Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ פַּטִּימָן (fem.).
Y. Meg. IV, 74ᵈ bot. מחזר פ׳ (ו)בני תורין ordered a translator (of התרים וכ׳, Lev. I, 14) who read ‘fatlings and young doves’ to take it back (and correct); a. e.—Fem. פַּטִּימָא, פַּטִּימְתָּא.
<cite ref="Targum of I Chronicles 4:40">Targ. I Chr. IV, 40</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:1">Lam. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>תרנגולא פ׳</he> (<cite ref="T00152"><he>רבתי</he></cite>) a fattened hen; a. e.—Pl. <he>פַּטִּימָן</he>, <he>פַּטִּימָתָא</he>.
<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 41:2">Targ. O. Gen. XLI, 2</cite> (Y. <he>פְּטִ׳</he>). Ib. 5; a. fr.—Y. Kidd. l. c., v. supra.

<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 1:15">Esth. R. to I, 3</cite> (in Hebr. diction) <he>שמא לא יצאת ידי קנדלה פ׳</he> did you perhaps fail to provide perfumed (good) oil for the lamps?, opp. <cite ref="Q01481"><he>פקטים</he></cite>.
